title: Kiln local qualification receipt
description: Closed record of one local qualification run: source identity, execution envelope, selected backend and device, optional model identity, workload inputs, effective configuration, case outcomes, measurements, and hashed evidence. The Python validator enforces cross-field verdict, timestamp, platform, model, source, and artifact rules beyond this JSON Schema. A receipt is unsigned and has no self-digest; validate it and independently establish custody before treating it as trusted evidence.

schema_version.description: Qualification receipt contract version. The validator accepts only version 1.

receipt_id.description: Stable receipt label generated from time, backend, host, workload, and variant identity. It names the record but is not a content hash, signature, or uniqueness proof.

created_at_utc.description: UTC time when the receipt was created. The semantic validator requires it not to precede qualification.finished_at_utc.

source.description: Identity of the source inputs and Git state observed for the run. The source-tree digest covers a defined repository subset; it does not hash this receipt, model files, result artifacts, or historical receipts.

tree_hash_format.description: Algorithm and inclusion-policy identifier used by scripts/qualification/source_tree_hash.py.

tree_hash.description: SHA-256 identity of tracked source inputs selected by kiln-source-tree-v1, including file mode, path, byte length, and content digest.

git_commit.description: Lowercase 40-hex Git commit recorded at run start. Existence is checked only when validation uses --require-known-commit.

git_worktree_clean.description: Whether the Git worktree was clean at run start. A passed receipt requires true; the runner also fails a run if a clean worktree becomes dirty.

qualification.description: Runner-owned summary of the qualification category, backend family, profile, final verdict, wall-clock interval, and argv invocation.

kind.description: Purpose of the run. Non-environment runs require workload identity; passed serving, performance, training, eval, and soak runs also require model identity.

backend.description: Portable backend family selected by the workload variant. Device name and architecture are recorded separately and do not constrain this enum to a specific machine.

profile.description: Human-readable workload profile label. The local runner derives it from the workload ID and truncates it to 128 characters.

verdict.description: Final runner verdict. Passed requires every required result to pass and a clean source tree; failed requires at least one required result to fail or be skipped.

finished_at_utc.description: UTC run-finish time. It may not precede started_at_utc.

duration_seconds.description: Finite non-negative runner-observed wall time. It must agree with the start and finish timestamps within one second.

command.description: Non-empty argv array for the qualification runner invocation. It is recorded as evidence, not replayed or shell-interpreted during receipt validation.

environment.description: Host, operating-system, selected-device, runtime, compiler, and optional platform-specific observations captured around the run. These observations identify the measured environment; they are not a portable device allowlist.

host_id.description: Operator-supplied stable host label used in receipt identity. It is not a hardware fingerprint or authenticated machine identity.

os.description: Operating-system identity reported by the environment probes.

name.description: Operating-system family reported by the host.

version.description: Operating-system version reported by the host.

kernel.description: Kernel release or build reported by the host.

architecture.description: Host processor architecture reported by the operating system.

device.description: Selected accelerator or CPU identity and capacity reported by backend probes. Optional fields remain null when a backend cannot report them.

name.description: Backend-reported device name for the selected logical device.

architecture.description: Backend-reported device architecture or target family.

memory_bytes.description: Total selected-device memory in bytes, or null when the probe cannot determine it.

unified_memory.description: Whether the selected device shares its memory pool with the host.

driver.description: Backend or operating-system driver identity reported for the selected device.

logical_index.description: Zero-based backend-visible device index, or null when no stable index is reported.

device_uuid.description: Backend-reported device UUID, or null when unavailable. WSL2 NVML temperature evidence must match this value.

pci_bus_id.description: PCI bus identifier for the selected device, or null when unavailable or inapplicable.

compute_capability.description: Backend-specific compute capability or feature-level text, or null when the backend does not expose one.

compute_units.description: Positive count of backend-reported compute units, cores, or equivalent parallel units, or null when unavailable.

memory_available_bytes.description: Available selected-device memory at capture time, or null when unavailable. It may not exceed memory_bytes.

runtime.description: Non-empty map of runtime identities captured by probes, such as Kiln, backend API, or execution-environment versions.

compiler.description: Non-empty map of compiler and toolchain identities captured by probes.

platform.description: Optional WSL2- or macOS-specific capability declarations and observations. Capability status must agree with the corresponding evidence.

model.description: Model and tokenizer content identity for the measured run, or null when no model applies or a failed run could not establish it. Passed serving, performance, training, eval, and soak receipts require this object.

workload.description: Committed workload identity, seed, and resolved parameters, or null only for environment qualification. The digest identifies the exact workload file bytes.

effective_config.description: Configuration the command-produced cases proved they actually used. The local runner copies the selected variant only when every command-owned case reports an exact match; otherwise this object is empty and affected results fail.

results.description: Runner-normalized, repetition-aggregated case outcomes in workload order. Required result status determines the receipt verdict; a passed receipt cannot contain a failed or skipped required result.

metrics.description: Optional run-level measurements. The local workload runner currently emits case measurements under results and leaves this array empty; consumers must not silently combine the two scopes.

artifacts.description: Content-addressed evidence files for probes, model fingerprints, command output, normalized case results, and effective run configuration. Hash verification is opt-in for local_ignored files and is not performed for external locations.

unsupported.description: Non-empty capability or probe limitations reported by environment capture. Entries explain missing evidence; they do not automatically change the verdict.

notes.description: Non-empty runner annotations about this record, including receipt downgrades. Notes are explanatory text, not signed assertions or machine-enforced policy.

capabilityStatus.description: Whether a platform-specific probe established the named capability. For observed WSL2 and macOS capabilities, this declaration must agree with the corresponding evidence.

configValue.description: One finite JSON scalar, null, or recursively nested configuration object. List values are excluded so comparison code can address leaves with unambiguous dot paths.

configObject.description: Configuration namespace with lowercase, dot-path-compatible keys and finite scalar, null, or nested-object values.

timestamp.description: UTC RFC 3339 timestamp ending in Z, with optional fractional seconds. The Python validator parses the value and enforces relevant ordering relationships.

sha256.description: SHA-256 digest written as sha256: followed by 64 lowercase hexadecimal characters. Syntax alone does not verify the referenced content.

nonemptyStringMap.description: Non-empty object of non-empty string values used for probe-reported runtime, compiler, or platform detail identities.

nullableSha256.description: A SHA-256 content digest or null when the corresponding optional input does not exist.

weightFile.description: One model weight shard identified by path, byte length, and SHA-256 content digest.

path.description: Weight-file path recorded by model fingerprinting. Paths must be unique within the model record.

sha256.description: SHA-256 digest of this weight file's bytes.

model.description: Content identity for the exact model directory observed before and after qualification. The runner fails if the final fingerprint differs from the initial one.

path.description: Model directory path used by fingerprinting. This is location evidence, not a portable download identifier.

weight_files.description: Non-empty set of uniquely named weight shards and their content identities.

config_hash.description: SHA-256 identity of the model configuration content selected by fingerprinting.

tokenizer_hash.description: Aggregate SHA-256 identity of tokenizer inputs selected by fingerprinting.

chat_template_hash.description: SHA-256 identity of the chat template when present, otherwise null.

workload.description: Identity and resolved inputs for the workload contract that produced the receipt.

id.description: Workload ID copied from the validated workload contract.

sha256.description: SHA-256 digest of the exact committed workload JSON file bytes.

seed.description: Deterministic non-negative seed delivered to each case, or null for a workload that explicitly declares no seed.

parameters.description: Resolved run parameters. The local runner records variant_id plus every operator-supplied workload variable.

metric.description: One finite measurement and the unit, aggregation, and direction required to interpret it. Metric names must be unique within their containing array.

name.description: Stable metric identifier declared by the workload result protocol and, when compared, by its metric rule.

value.description: Finite observed or repetition-aggregated value. The Python validator rejects NaN and infinity.

unit.description: Non-empty measurement unit. Compared metrics must match the committed workload rule exactly.

aggregation.description: Non-empty aggregation label. Repeated command metrics are emitted as mean_of_<count>_<original aggregation>.

lower_is_better.description: Recorded metric direction. It must match the committed workload rule when the metric participates in comparison.

result.description: Runner-normalized outcome for one workload case after all repetitions, output assertions, structured-result checks, and infrastructure checks.

id.description: Unique case ID copied from the selected workload variant.

required.description: Whether this case gates the receipt verdict. Every required result must pass for the receipt to pass.

status.description: Final runner-owned case status after command status and runner, contract, source, model, and infrastructure failures are applied.

duration_seconds.description: Finite sum of runner-observed monotonic durations across this case's repetitions.

metrics.description: Command- or runner-owned measurements aggregated across repetitions. Per-execution advisory tolerances are not copied into this result.

details.description: Optional bounded diagnostic text combined from case executions and runner or infrastructure failures.

artifact.description: Content identity for one evidence file referenced by the receipt. The receipt records hashes but does not embed, sign, or automatically retrieve the content.

kind.description: Evidence-role label, such as environment_probes, case_stdout, case_result, model_fingerprint, or effective_run_config.

location.description: Custody class. local_ignored evidence can be verified under .qualification with --require-local-artifacts; external evidence is not fetched or hash-checked by the validator.

path.description: Artifact path or external locator. The validator constrains local_ignored paths to .qualification only when local verification is requested.

sha256.description: Claimed SHA-256 digest of the artifact bytes. It is recomputed only for locally verified local_ignored evidence.

bytes.description: Claimed artifact size in bytes. It is checked against file length only for locally verified local_ignored evidence.
